reviews.title: Calming and Fun
reviews.text: This is such a calming and fun game. I’m caught up on all the current quests and excited for the new ones to drop. In the meantime, I’m playing mini games and working on my relationships with all the residents! I’m confused about the comments with ad complaints, because most of the ads are optional, and I only have maybe one ad pop up per day that isn’t tied to a reward.  Compared to most other free games, that’s super nice. I also rarely choose to watch an ad for a reward, and I’ve been able to progress through the game at a good pace! Also acorns have been perfect easy to earn and use to buy keys, stamps, etc. I haven’t had any glitches that I can think of.

reviews.title: So fun with minor fixes
reviews.text:
I like the music and environment, its a very relaxing and cozy game. I just wanted to note a few things that would make it even better. 
1) the mini games say they use 10 energy each, when really it takes away 12 energy each time you play. So when you have full energy of 50, you can only play 4 times and not 5. Please fix this!
2) I would like more customization options at home, for instance it doesnt allow you to move the position of your bed. And you cannot rotate any items either so it makes customizing kind of limiting. Would love to see this updated.
I’ve currently finished all the quests and Looking forward to what comes next!

reviews.title: Adorably cozy game
reviews.text:
I absolutely love this game! It is so fun and cozy and very relaxed. I played it before the developers made a big update and fixed a lot of things and I can already tell that the update fixed a lot. The games are fun and feasible, and the characters all have their quirks - which is such a great addition! 

Problems I have experienced/ things that aren’t quite my favorite:
1. I don’t particularly like the fact that in order to get explorer keys, which you need to progress in the game, the price just keeps getting significantly higher each time you purchase. It makes it a little hard to progress.

2. I seem to have encountered a bug of some sorts, after buying a house every time I put any decorations on the wall (including windows) they disappear whenever I reload the game. The app still says they are placed but you can’t see them.

Things I love:
1. I love the art style! It gives the perfect combination of cozy and aesthetic!

2. I love the fact that each character has their own likes and dislikes, as well as their own phrases and all around personality. 

3. I love the decorations available in the game! As a plant girly I especially love the fact that there are a lot of plant options!

Anyways, either way I do super highly recommend you play this game! It is super fun and relaxing, and the perfect way to wind-down after a long day in the real world.

reviews.title: Cute but takes your money
reviews.text:
This game is cute and looked like something I'd play longterm, so I wanted to buy the no ads forever package. It happened to be on sale (Blossom Season) so I was like great, I'll grab that. 

Well, my $12.99 was certainly taken from me. But the purchase itself seems to be bugged, because it keeps saying I've obtained the ad free thing (it seems to function like an item that would go into your inventory), but it's not actually giving it to me. I've tried everything but deleting the app or requesting a refund. 

I'm really hoping this can be fixed because if not, I'll just end up requesting said refund. If this game weren't so cute and interesting I would have already done it, but I want to give the devs a chance to rectify it. 

And, for what it's worth, there is no CLEAR way to contact support via the app (I happened to just and just find a way via main menu, restore purchases), which is kind of really bad company reflection. It implies that there could absolutely be no issues for users to ever have to reach out to support for, which in and of itself is... gross, but considering there's literal issues regarding PURCHASES is... wow. Seriously, make that easier to find. 

I'm gonna give it about three days to see if I get this fixed and update my review accordingly, but for now, I can tentatively recommend this app because it IS cute, but I cannot under any circumstances recommend making any purchases within it. 

Also, after digging around on the actual developer website, the fact that this app is pushed towards young children and school systems but having issues like this is, once again, massive red flag.

reviews.title: FINALLY a vertical cozy game that’s so GOOD!
reviews.text:
Forest Fables is the first game that made me go, “Wait… do I actually want to buy something?” Not because I need it to keep playing (because it’s very playable without paying for anything), but because you can feel how much love and detail went into every corner of this game. The music? A vibe. The art? Adorable. The layout? Super organized!

It’s cozy without being boring, peaceful without putting me to sleep, and has just enough mystery to keep me side-eyeing the shadows like, “What are you hiding, lil forest?” (Which is so cool that they put a little mystery into a cozy sim!!) 

Also, it’s vertical. (Such a plus for me you have no idea) 
My lazy hand says thank you.

If you like chill games with heart, this one’s a gem for sure.
